q: The chart gives this variation; your compass has no deviation. Your plotted true course is 090°. What do you steer?
why: True to magnetic: add west ("west is best").

q: The compass reads 215°C. Deviation on this heading is 3°E, variation 2°W. What is the true course?
why: Compass → true: add east, subtract west: 215 + 3 − 2 = 216.

q: Your plotted course is shown. What compass course do you give the helmsman?
why: True to compass: subtract east, add west: 120 − 3 + 2 = 119.

q: The plotter shows this bearing to the next waypoint. Ignoring deviation, what magnetic course do you steer?
why: True to magnetic: subtract easterly variation, 200 − 5.
